properties.title: Plasma lactate and severity of illness for acute pulmonary embolism: A Bayesian probability model

properties.journal: International Journal of Critical Illness and Injury Science16:67–71

properties.name: SI/sPESI-lactate Bayesian risk calculator
properties.mechanism: Published pretest mortality odds × lactateLR -> posterior mortality risk; probability shift is information update, not health dynamics.

scope.population: Published aggregate acute pulmonary embolism risk strata

assertions.applicability_reason: Static aggregate risk calculator has no health-world trajectory, propagated patient state, multimodal encoder, action simulator, causal contrast, planner or agent. Updating mortality odds on diagnostic evidence does not advance physiology; RL/MDP trajectories are future applications.

legacy_cells.B: Plasma lactate and severity of illness for acute pulmonary embolism: A Bayesian probability model
legacy_cells.C: Amado Alejandro Báez; Faith IBU; helena Halasz
legacy_cells.E: international journal of critical illness and injury science
legacy_cells.I: 029_2026_Plasma lactate and severity of illness for acute pulmonary embolism A Bayesian probability model.pdf
legacy_cells.S: Does integrating plasma lactate (>2 mmol/L) with SI or sPESI improve 30-day mortality risk estimation in acute PE?
legacy_cells.ER: Ethics-exempt mathematical modeling study using published, de-identified data
legacy_cells.FL: Bayesian nomogram combines pretest probabilities from SI or sPESI with lactate likelihood ratios to calculate posttest mortality probabilities, with no encoder, temporal transition, or planner described.
legacy_cells.FM: Integrates plasma lactate with SI and sPESI in a Bayesian probability model to assess prognostic diagnostic gain for acute PE.
legacy_cells.FN: For SI, lactate integration yielded ADG 16.3% (low-risk) and 25.9% (high-risk), with BNND 6 and 4, while sPESI yielded ADG 3.5% and 16.3%, with BNND 29 and 6.
legacy_cells.FO: Authors note pooled-literature data may introduce publication bias and inter-study heterogeneity, and call for prospective standardized multicenter validation.
legacy_cells.FP: Authors propose integrating multimodal physiologic inputs and combining Bayesian inference with machine learning and dynamic decision algorithms.
legacy_cells.FQ: Authors state that lactate's prognostic value is recognized but its integration into quantitative decision models has been limited.
legacy_cells.FR: The reported work computes posttest mortality probabilities from risk scores and lactate likelihood ratios. It does not demonstrate persistent patient-state dynamics, alternative treatment rollouts, causal identification, planning, prospective validation, or improved patient outcomes.
legacy_cells.FT: Keep Bayesian updating of a diagnostic risk estimate distinct from a temporal patient-state transition; a changing posterior alone is not evidence of a world model.
legacy_cells.FX: PDF pp. 1–5: title and abstract, introduction, study design and methods (clinical scores, data sources, Bayesian integration, statistical analysis), results, discussion and future applications, limitations, conclusion, ethics statement, and references. No tables were present in the extracted text; the reported results and limitations were readable. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: A:I left unchanged. The reported model updates mortality-risk probabilities using published aggregate clinical inputs, not evolving patient states. No table-related extraction issue was present. FS and FU module/open-problem mappings were omitted because their referenced KB mapping was not among the supplied inputs. Evidence QA: 14/29 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (48.3%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Codex audit: 28 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 1 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. Prior unsupported/missing fields remain Not reported; no clinical benefit inferred from offline simulation.

limitations: Model-assisted review; no independent human review or reproduction.
Pooled literature inputs with publicationbias/heterogeneity and unclear overlapping endpoint/cohort identity; no patient-level heldout validation.
ADG/BNND describe posterior probability changes, not observed diagnostic accuracy gain or clinical benefit.
